fatigue.note: Anti-stalemate rule: once the combat has lasted "start" attacks, all servants lose "increment" more HP at each turn (1, 2, 3…).

settlement.note: End of combat: each survivor of the winning side strikes the other side. Damage of a survivor = its rank x perRank + flat. The player's survivors strike the Boss; the Boss's survivors strike the player's lieutenants (one at a time: the only lieutenant with the "taunt" keyword if there is exactly one, otherwise a random living one; a lieutenant with the "absorb" keyword cancels the first hit it would take).

order.note: Resolution order of the start-of-combat effects. direction: leftToRight or rightToLeft inside a band. Powers can change bands, direction and replays through the event resolutionOrder, and the first attacker through the event firstSide (spec 12.3); the priority of a power is start.priority in its template. bands: who plays first (boss = the Boss's own power, opponent = the Boss's board, lieutenants = the player's lieutenants, ally = the player's board). replays: inBand = a side's replays right after its other effects; afterAll = all the replays after every other effect.
